mapper.sql: cert.id, cert.code, cert.user_id, u.display_name AS learner_name, cert.course_id, c.title AS course_title, c.slug AS course_slug, i.display_name AS instructor_name, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ch.duration_min), 0) FROM chapters ch WHERE ch.course_id = c.id) AS total_minutes, cert.issued_at
FROM certificates cert JOIN users u ON u.id = cert.user_id JOIN courses c ON c.id = cert.course_id JOIN users i ON i.id = c.instructor_id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO certificates (user_id, course_id, code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{courseId}, #{code})
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE cert.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cert.issued_at DESC
